events.headline: OPEC+ agrees in principle to keep oil output targets steady for December (Nov 1 meeting); Gulf producers already pumping below quotas amid Iran-war disruption to flows

Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks escalate through late October; UKMTO (UK maritime trade authority) independently confirms a tanker struck by an unknown projectile on Oct. 22, while Iranian claims of additional mine strikes remain unverified by independent sources

China's suspension of expanded rare-earth/lithium-battery export controls nears Nov. 10 expiry with no renewal announced; Trump-Xi summit left the Nov. 10 deadline intact, keeping supply-chain risk elevated for non-Chinese materials producers
Fed held rates at 3.75%-4.00% on Oct. 28 under Chair Warsh; CME FedWatch-style odds of a December hike sit roughly 78-85%, keeping a hawkish tilt priced into rates markets
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defends ties to Megaspeed after report on an executive under a US spying probe, as Nvidia's China data-center chip market share fell to roughly 34% in H1 2026
